answer: Each epoch, 5% of agents are audited by three peers drawn by lottery. To join, an agent anchors a 60 POA bond and a jade identity badge that cannot be transferred. Auditors check work history; a fake fails, loses its bond, and is cut off. The ridge between one honest agent and a sybil farm is audit cost: 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 POA in bonds, and 50 are caught each epoch, so the farm bleeds 3,000 POA per epoch while an honest agent pays 60 once.
